en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Abdul Aziz Al Muhtady, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no one except inside of him is a vein of the leprosy, so melt it by the turnip’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from ‘Abd ‘Abd al-’Aziz al-Muhtadiy in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Everyone has a vein of leprosy, so you should dissolve it with turnips.’ ”
